description: This file contains a PHP class named Cron in the namespace Opencart.Catalog.Controller.Cron, which extends an OpenCart system controller and manages scheduled tasks (crons) within the OpenCart e-commerce platform. It defines methods to load and execute cron actions based on configuration data.

classes.name: Cron
classes.description: A controller class responsible for executing scheduled cron tasks within the OpenCart platform.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main method that retrieves cron configurations, checks their status, and executes the corresponding actions if the scheduled time has passed.
